checks.title: Has an email capture
checks.detail: No email capture found. A launch page without a capture is a poster, not a funnel.
checks.fix: Add one email field and one button above the fold. Keep it to one step.

checks.title: Has a specific call to action
checks.fix: Add one primary button above the fold with a verb and a concrete outcome.

checks.title: Keeps signup friction low
checks.fix: Start with a single email field.

checks.title: Offers a human contact path
checks.detail: No email or contact link found.
checks.fix: Add a real email or a contact page. Buyers check for a human before they convert.

checks.title: States a clear value proposition
checks.detail: H1 is only “corgi” — likely a brand name, not a promise.
checks.fix: Pair the brand with the outcome: “LaunchGrade — grade your launch in 60 seconds”.

checks.title: Reverses the risk of clicking
checks.detail: No “no spam”, “free”, or “cancel anytime” reassurance found.
checks.fix: Put one short reassurance under the button: “Free. No spam. Unsubscribe anytime.”

checks.title: Links a privacy policy
checks.fix: Publish a plain-language privacy page and link it in the footer and near every form.

checks.title: Links terms of service
checks.fix: Add a short terms page. It matters as soon as money changes hands.

checks.title: Explains who is behind the page
checks.detail: No about or team link found.
checks.fix: Add a short “who we are” section. Anonymous launch pages convert worse.

checks.title: Publishes a security contact
checks.fix: Add one when you start handling accounts or payments.

checks.title: Shows a current footer
checks.fix: Add a footer with company name, year and legal links.

checks.title: Declares a canonical URL
checks.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://yourdomain.com/"> to prevent duplicate-URL dilution.

checks.title: Measures visits
checks.fix: Add privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible, Umami, or a simple counter) before you announce.

checks.title: Defines image dimensions
checks.detail: 12/12 images are missing valid width and height attributes.
checks.fix: Add explicit width and height attributes to images to help prevent layout shifts.

checks.title: Has a well-sized title
checks.detail: Title is 5 characters; search results truncate around 60.
checks.fix: Keep the promise in the first 60 characters.

checks.title: Has a meta description
checks.fix: Aim for 50–160 characters with the outcome and audience.

checks.title: Describes its images
checks.fix: Add concise alt text to every meaningful image.

checks.title: Publishes a sitemap
checks.fix: Generate /sitemap.xml and submit it in Google Search Console.

checks.title: Adds structured data
checks.fix: Add Organization + WebSite (or Product/SoftwareApplication) schema in one script tag.

checks.title: Links its own pages
checks.fix: Add a footer with links to your key pages.
